name: 41-sasnalkahi
description: Sasnalkahi: a huge dark-brown grizzly bear monster standing hunched on four legs, glowing red eyes, pale claws. Flat black-outline pixel art, flat dark/mid/light brown fur ramp, no fur texture.

idle.action: Menacing idle: the bear breathes heavily in place, shoulders rising and falling, head lowering slightly and lifting again, facing the same direction throughout. Same size, ground line, black one-pixel outlines and flat brown fills. No walking, effects or texture.
